blocks.text: JAKARTA, Indonesia — Indonesian rescuers searched Monday for 34 missing workers after a deadly fire swept through a candy facotry, west of Jakarta. Saturday’s fire broke out at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory in Banten province. Firefighters battled flames for about 14 hours before largely containing the blaze tearing through the three-story building. About 300 workers were inside the factory when the fire erupted, officials said. Of those, 63 were believed to have been in the hardest-hit area, mostly on the second floor where the flames originated from a cooling unit.
